messages:
marisa_peopleops: Quick heads-up — Oliver (new hire) starts Mon 9:00am PT / 18:00 CET. Opening a thread for logistics: I-9 options, badge pickup, laptop, and benefits timing. Please confirm ownership of items below.

nina_recruiter: Oliver confirmed travel details. He'll be onsite Tue afternoon for a quick badge handoff but wants Day 1 remote-friendly if possible.

oliver_newhire: Hi team — super excited to join. Two quick Qs: my passport is being renewed (current passport expired last month) and my SSN card is with my parents. Is there a workaround for Day 1 I-9? Also can benefits orientation be recorded or scheduled later in CET?

marisa_peopleops: We can do a mobile-notary / temporary remote verification flow. Benefits session: we'll record the main session and set a 1:1 for region-friendly time. Action items below.

marisa_peopleops: ```
I-9 & verification options for Oliver:
- Standard: unexpired passport OR drivers license + SSN card (presented in person)
- Intl with expired passport: notarized copy of passport + embassy/consulate letter OR mobile notary + in-person follow-up within 3 business days
- If documents delayed >3 days: issue temporary access + escalate to HR compliance for exception
```

tony_itops: I'll own badge & kiosk reservation. Tentatively reserving Tue 10:30am at SF kiosk. Assigning @sophie-mentor to meet Oliver and walk through desk/badge.

sophie-mentor: Happy to meet him. I'll block 10:15-11:00 for escort and quick setup. Can request workstation/keyboard if needed.

tony_itops: Laptop courier scheduled: ship Mon EOD to Oliver's address. If passport docs arrive earlier, we can swap courier to hold until verification completed.

marisa_peopleops: Background check status: pending (HR ops received consent, vendor started). I'll ping vendor for ETA.

oliver_newhire: Thanks — for the notary option, where do I upload the notarized docs? And what's the window to complete the in-person follow-up?

marisa_peopleops: Upload to our secure doc portal (link: https://redwood-secure/hr-upload) — use the "New Hire Docs" folder and tag with your name. In-person follow-up required within 3 business days of remote verification. If that's not feasible, we'll apply for a time-limited exception and notify you.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "Badge pickup / office escort — Oliver" Tue 10:30am PT, guests: oliver_newhire, sophie-mentor, tony_itops.

marisa_peopleops: Summary / owners: 
- Badge & kiosk slot: @tony_itops (reserved)
- Mentor escort & desk setup: @sophie-mentor
- Laptop shipping: @tony_itops (Mon EOD)
- I-9 notary / doc intake: @marisa_peopleops + Oliver to upload to portal
- Benefits recording + 1:1 regional slot: @marisa_peopleops to arrange
- Background check follow-up: @nina_recruiter to track with vendor

marisa_peopleops: Please react with :thumbsup: when your item is confirmed. If anyone needs to swap ownership, call it out here so we don't miss Day 1. Thanks!"
